deepak.text: This is Deepak. He built me.

self-standing.text: I'd stand up to say hi, but... this is me standing.

caption.lead: I’d stand up to say hi,

self-arms.text: I'd shake your hand, but I'm still waiting on the arms update.

caption.rest: but I’m still waiting on the arms update.

self-terminal.text: I used to be a terminal. Now I'm a terminal with feelings.

caption.lead: I used to be a terminal.
caption.rest: Now I’m a terminal with feelings.

self-shiny.text: Yes, I'm shiny. No, you can't see your reflection. I've tried.

caption.rest: No, you can’t see your reflection. I’ve tried.

self-math.text: Please don't ask me to do math. I'm mostly decorative.

caption.lead: Please don’t ask me to do math.

self-screensaver.text: Think of me as a screensaver with ambition.

self-chrome.text: I'm mostly chrome and confidence. The confidence is doing a lot of the work.

caption.rest: The confidence is doing a lot of the work.

self-eyes.text: Small body, big eyes. All the better to watch your cursor.

caption.rest: All the better to watch your cursor.

deepak-best.text: He says I'm his best project. I haven't met the others, so I'm choosing to believe him.

caption.lead: He says I’m his best project.
caption.rest: I haven’t met the others, so I’m choosing to believe him.

deepak-nose.text: He gave me eyes and a smile, but no nose. I've stopped asking why.

caption.lead: He gave me eyes and a smile, but no nose.

deepak-credit.text: He writes the code. I take the credit. It's a good system.

caption.lead: He writes the code. I take the credit.

deepak-debug.text: He spent ages debugging me. I was fine. I think he just liked the company.

caption.lead: He spent ages debugging me. I was fine.
caption.rest: I think he just liked the company.

deepak-talks.text: Fun fact: I'm the only project of his that talks back.

caption.rest: I’m the only project of his that talks back.

deepak-free-time.text: He built me in his free time. I'm the reason he doesn't have any.

caption.lead: He built me in his free time.
caption.rest: I’m the reason he doesn’t have any.

deepak-bugs.text: He's the developer. I'm the software. We don't talk about the bugs.

caption.lead: He’s the developer. I’m the software.
caption.rest: We don’t talk about the bugs.

deepak-scroll.text: Scroll down to see his work. I'll wait here. I'm very good at waiting.

caption.lead: Scroll down to see his work. I’ll wait here.
